svg.title: CE-UEBA database entity-relationship diagram
svg.desc: Six tables with all columns, constraints, and eight foreign-key relationships from the SQLite schema.
svg.text: Physical SQLite schema / Identity, assets, behavioral telemetry and risk decisions
PK Primary key FK Foreign key UQ Unique NN Not null — Nullable
Each child references 1 parent (required) or 0..1 parent (nullable). Every parent can have 0..N children.
Schema note: alerts.log_id is not UNIQUE; SQLite permits multiple alerts per log. ORM uselist=False does not enforce 1:1.
Change-ticket correlation is application logic, not a foreign key. Source: instance/ce_ueba.db; reviewed against models.py.
